Each category link now uses `prefetch={true}` in [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:15). Next fetches the full `/catalog?category=...` destination, including its heading and products, in the background. Once that prefetch completes, the click can use the prepared data without waiting for a server render or showing the loading fallback.

The production build passed, and both category URLs returned their expected headings and products.
